name: John F. Kennedy International
tip: Shared-ride and pre-booked car pickups are at the Ground Transportation counters after baggage claim; pre-booked drivers usually meet in the arrivals hall.

name: LaGuardia
tip: Rideshare pickup is in dedicated lots reached by shuttle bus — pre-booked private cars can often meet you closer to the terminal.

name: Newark Liberty International
tip: Heading to Manhattan? Allow extra time for Lincoln/Holland tunnel traffic in peak hours.

name: Los Angeles International
tip: Taxis and rideshare leave from the LAX-it lot; many private transfer drivers meet curbside on the arrivals level instead.

name: San Francisco International
tip: Shared-ride vans load on the upper level (departures) outer curb at most terminals.

name: O'Hare International
tip: The Blue Line is cheap but the private transfer wins with luggage or groups of 3+.

name: Miami International
taxi: Flat rates by zone to Miami Beach
tip: Cruise passengers: pre-book a transfer to PortMiami — taxis queue long on ship days.

name: Orlando International
tip: Theme-park families save most with a private van — one fare instead of per-person shared tickets.

name: Harry Reid International
tip: Shared shuttles to the Strip are the cheapest option for solo travellers.

name: Toronto Pearson International
tip: The UP Express reaches Union Station in about 25 minutes; transfers win for hotels outside downtown.

name: Montréal–Trudeau International
tip: The 747 bus runs 24/7 to downtown; private transfers are best with kids and car seats.

name: Vancouver International
tip: Cruise transfers to Canada Place are in high demand in summer — book early.

name: Mexico City International
tip: Only use authorised taxis or pre-booked transfers from inside the terminal.

name: Cancún International
tip: Pre-booking is strongly recommended — walk-up taxi rates in Cancún are among the highest in the region.

name: São Paulo/Guarulhos
tip: Traffic to the centre can exceed 90 minutes at rush hour — plan buffers for departures.

name: London Heathrow
tip: Private-hire drivers meet in the arrivals hall; they cannot wait at the kerb, so share your flight number for tracking.

name: London Gatwick
tip: Private transfers are best value for 3+ people to central London.

name: Paris Charles de Gaulle
tip: Official taxis have fixed fares to Paris — ignore touts in the arrivals hall.

name: Amsterdam Schiphol
tip: Trains are fast and frequent; private transfers are worth it for families and late arrivals.

name: Frankfurt Airport
tip: Large terminal — tell your driver whether you land at T1 or T2.

name: Adolfo Suárez Madrid–Barajas
tip: Madrid taxis charge a fixed fare to the city centre within the M-30 ring.

name: Barcelona–El Prat
tip: Cruise-port transfers: allow extra time on busy summer turnaround days.

name: Rome Fiumicino
tip: Fixed taxi fare applies only to official white taxis — confirm before departure.

name: Istanbul Airport
tip: Distances are long — a pre-booked transfer avoids meter disputes.

name: Dubai International
tip: Taxis are plentiful, but luxury and van transfers are popular for families and business travellers.

name: Hamad International
tip: Transit-passenger city tours and transfers are a popular add-on during long layovers.

name: Indira Gandhi International
tip: Use prepaid taxi counters or pre-booked transfers; confirm the terminal (T1/T2/T3).

name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International
tip: Traffic in Mumbai is unpredictable — book departures with a generous buffer.

name: Bandaranaike International
tip: Beach resorts on the west and south coast are 1–3 hours away — private transfers dominate.

name: Singapore Changi
tip: Changi's shared shuttle desks are at arrivals halls of every terminal.

name: Suvarnabhumi
tip: Use the official taxi queue on Level 1 or a pre-booked driver to avoid inflated fares.

name: Tokyo Haneda
tip: Airport Limousine Bus is the classic shared option to major hotels.

name: Tokyo Narita
tip: Narita is far — shared buses and trains are dramatically cheaper than private cars.

name: Hong Kong International
tip: Hotel shuttle coaches cover most Kowloon and HK Island hotels.

name: Sydney Kingsford Smith
tip: The train has a steep station access fee — groups often save with a shared van.

name: Melbourne Airport
tip: SkyBus runs 24/7 to Southern Cross Station.

name: Auckland Airport
tip: Shared door-to-door shuttles are popular and good value for couples.

name: O.R. Tambo International
tip: Pre-book a transfer for late arrivals; use the Gautrain for daytime trips to Sandton.

name: Cape Town International
tip: Winelands and Garden Route transfers are popular multi-stop bookings.

name: Cairo International
tip: Agree the price in advance or pre-book — pyramid-area hotels are 60+ minutes away.
